source_units.text: Explain a terminology policy for a fictional translation project.
Its intended audience: translators working on the invented Riverglass story.
These invented details are required: The invented device name moonwell is fixed across languages: do not translate it.
Its ordinary description can be localized.
Any alternate spelling must be recorded in a glossary entry before drafting.
Include each of these exact strings: "moonwell", "do not translate", "glossary entry".
Keep the tone editorial and practical.
Keep the complete piece to 55–85 words.
